newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks bounce back in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks bounce back in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks bounced back in early Monday morning trade recovering from the tailspin brought on by the Federal Reserve Board chairman's comments on Friday, brokers said. Smaller-than-expected falls in Wall Street and in Chicago on Friday encouraged Tokyo, they said.
As of 0013 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was up 293.97 points or 1.45 percent at 20,570.67. Its December futures were up 470 points at 20,680.
Brokers said Tokyo market overreacted to Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's comments and the benchmark was climbing back up, led by purchases in global issues.
